_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 14 — arm 12 (single-layer canonical) with the rx-CB CARRY OFF.
THE PUMP-ATTRIBUTION DISCRIMINATOR.  Single knob: network.carry_rx_code_bias false
(the datum KEEPS the pl_cb walk and stays armed; datum-only fills the vector and no
one harvests it — the documented intended shape).
MECHANISM UNDER TEST (ApplicationNetworkAssembly.cpp ~:2458): the carry injects each
station's rx-DCB as a diagonal prior toward its ABSOLUTE harvested value at q=1e-9
m²/s.  A converged carry (var ~1e-2 m²) puts ~100 information units on the
common-mode direction vs the datum's 1/sigma² = 0.01 — the FRAME direction is held
10,000:1 by last epoch's frame instead of being datum-realized fresh.  A frame
flywheel: invariant #1's stiff time-linked quantity, sitting on a gauge direction.
Fits every measured symptom: arm 2's -80 walk, arm 10's sag-to-8, arm 11's breathing,
and the innovation gate (built for receiver resets) withholding 56 % of injections.
PREDICTION (stated before the run):
- FLYWHEEL CONFIRMED: the ignition dip largely VANISHES (a00 holds ~22-30 through all
20 ep instead of diving to ~6 by ep 15), the deg-1 peak shrinks materially below arm
12's 34.6, and pl_cb innovation-skip counting is moot (no carry).  Cost: noisier
per-epoch rx-DCB estimates — acceptable; the datum + differences remain determined.
- FLYWHEEL REFUTED (dip/dipole unchanged): the pump lives elsewhere — next suspects
in order: the per-LOS iono carry / phase-leveling era dynamics, the SH coefficient
RW-toward-previous carry.  Name it before touching any knob (invariant #7).
If confirmed, the internal fix is NOT 'carry off' (the differences ARE worth carrying):
it is DE-MEANING the carried set per constellation at injection — carry the estimable
between-station differences, let the common mode re-realize on the datum each epoch.
In-tree precedent: Iono-2 v3 rep_error_demean (the anti-ratchet idiom).  Default-OFF
toggle (network.rx_cb_carry_demean), byte-identical when off, per the standing rules.
